basis.value_representation: Unmodified DuckDB CAST AS VARCHAR; SQL NULL is JSON null. Keys use the unchanged historical L0 normalization.

edits.old: avg(customer_acquisition_cost) FILTER(WHERE cumulative_conversions>0) over(partition by acquisition_cohort,advertising_channel_type) cohort_avg_cac
edits.new: AVG(CASE WHEN cumulative_conversions > 0 THEN cumulative_acquisition_cost / cumulative_conversions END) OVER (PARTITION BY acquisition_cohort, advertising_channel_type) AS cohort_avg_cac

edits.old: avg(average_customer_ltv) FILTER(WHERE cumulative_conversions>0) over(partition by acquisition_cohort,advertising_channel_type) cohort_avg_ltv
edits.new: AVG(CASE WHEN cumulative_conversions > 0 THEN cumulative_ltv / cumulative_conversions END) OVER (PARTITION BY acquisition_cohort, advertising_channel_type) AS cohort_avg_ltv

edits.old: percent_rank() over(partition by acquisition_cohort order by customer_acquisition_cost desc) cac_efficiency_percentile
edits.new: PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acquisition_cohort ORDER BY customer_acquisition_cost ASC) AS cac_efficiency_percentile

edits.old: percent_rank() over(partition by acquisition_cohort order by ltv_cac_ratio) ltv_cac_performance_percentile
edits.new: PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acquisition_cohort ORDER BY ltv_cac_ratio DESC) AS ltv_cac_performance_percentile

LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, COALESCE(channel_diversity_count * 15, 0) + COALESCE(active_campaigns_count * 5, 0) + CASE WHEN average_customer_ltv > 500 THEN 30 ELSE average_customer_ltv / 500 * 30 END + CASE WHEN ltv_cac_ratio >= 2.0 THEN 25 ELSE ltv_cac_ratio / 2.0 * 25 END)) AS acquisition_sophistication_score

edits.old: CASE WHEN ltv_cac_ratio>=4 AND average_customer_ltv>1000 THEN 'High-value scale customer' WHEN ltv_cac_ratio<.5 THEN 'Unprofitable customer' WHEN days_since_first_conversion<=30 THEN 'New customer development' WHEN cac_vs_cohort_pct>50 THEN 'High CAC customer' ELSE 'Core customer' END strategic_customer_segment
edits.new: CASE WHEN ltv_cac_ratio >= 3.0 AND average_customer_ltv >= 1000 THEN 'Premium Customer' WHEN ltv_cac_ratio >= 2.0 AND customer_acquisition_cost <= cohort_avg_cac THEN 'High Value Customer' WHEN ltv_cac_ratio >= 1.5 AND days_since_first_conversion <= 90 THEN 'Growth Opportunity' WHEN ltv_cac_ratio < 1.0 AND days_since_first_conversion > 180 THEN 'At Risk Customer' WHEN customer_acquisition_cost > cohort_avg_cac * 1.5 THEN 'High Cost Customer' ELSE 'Standard Customer' END AS strategic_customer_segment

edits.old: CASE WHEN ltv_cac_ratio>=3 AND cac_efficiency_percentile>=.8 THEN 'Scale acquisition investment' WHEN ltv_cac_ratio<.5 THEN 'Reduce acquisition cost' WHEN channel_diversity_count<2 THEN 'Diversify acquisition channels' WHEN cac_vs_cohort_pct>30 THEN 'Optimize CAC versus cohort' ELSE 'Maintain acquisition strategy' END acquisition_recommendation
edits.new: CASE WHEN ltv_cac_ratio >= 3.0 AND cac_efficiency_percentile >= 0.8 THEN 'Scale Aggressively' WHEN ltv_cac_ratio >= 2.0 AND channel_diversity_count < 3 THEN 'Expand Channels' WHEN ltv_cac_ratio < 1.0 AND days_since_first_conversion > 90 THEN 'Optimize or Pause' WHEN customer_acquisition_cost > cohort_avg_cac * 1.3 THEN 'Reduce Acquisition Spend' WHEN ltv_cac_ratio >= 1.5 AND active_campaigns_count < 5 THEN 'Increase Investment' ELSE 'Maintain Current Strategy' END AS acquisition_recommendation
